title: 若帆之阁阁 Ruofan zhi Ge ge
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 若帆之阁
evidence.excerpt_zh: 北逺山村東北度石橋折而西為湛虛翠軒又西為耕雲堂又西為若帆之閣湛虛翠軒東數十武有闗帝廟（圓明園册）臣等謹按若帆之閣下層額曰御風泠然上額曰平臨天境與湛虛翠軒諸額皆御書
evidence.summary: North-east of 北逺山村 over a stone bridge and west: 湛虛翠軒, 耕雲堂, the two-storey 若帆之閣 with a plaque per floor, and a 闗帝廟 a little to the east.

evidence.title: 若帆之阁
evidence.locator: v3 p.182, under 若帆之阁; source ref 8-815
evidence.excerpt_zh: 高阁平陵水之裔，动影漪摇网轩字。若帆题额真若帆，下浸烟波上云气。讵因风势为转旋，常与月轮共光霁。恰忆浮玉坐江楼，孰主孰宾孰同异。然予絜矩在羲经，时乘六龙御天际。
evidence.summary: Poem 若帆之阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

evidence.title: 若帆之阁
evidence.locator: v3 p.183, under 若帆之阁; source ref 8-825
evidence.excerpt_zh: 高阁临水名若帆，若帆妙义多包函。驹影之时阅以四，如环之运参以三。清风明月食无尽，舟行岸转疑有兼。而我取喻十思疏，更因切切畏民碞。设其肆志弗顾虑，挂席过驶危或阽。今朝西北来习习，正宜快霁因农忺。
evidence.summary: Poem 若帆之阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 若帆之阁.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
